title: Carbon dots in agriculture: fundamentals, applications and perspectives
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, 4,118-141
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00583C, Critical Review

Wenna Huang, Xiaotong Zhao, Yifan Zhang, Qiluan Cheng, Zuojun Tan, Hongwei Lei
Recent advances in CD synthesis, PL mechanism understanding, and their agricultural applications have been reviewed. The challenges and perspectives of CDs in agriculture have been discussed to inspire the sustainable development of agriculture.
